release_rule: Ronin Public v1 remains incomplete while any mandatory capability family lacks an end-to-end supported path.

capabilities.summary: Durable Job/Run/Attempt lifecycle, local/container execution, leases, heartbeat, fencing, reclaim, resume, cancellation, evidence and project-scoped HTTP/CLI/SDK foundation.

Workspace/project persistence, project manifests, Git identity, environments and deployment bindings exist; Public v1 API/UI, complete source-control lifecycle and multi-user membership remain incomplete.

Provider-neutral connection/discovery/checkpoint contracts, governed local CSV/JSONL ingestion, bounded HTTP/REST and PostgreSQL snapshot reads, S3-compatible/Azure Blob JSON/JSONL sources, Apache Ozone S3 Gateway JSON/JSONL support with path-style SigV4 addressing, and a fail-closed generic JDBC bridge profile with explicit watermark incremental reads, snapshot suppression, and content-addressed artifacts exist; production driver qualification and broader incremental source coverage remain incomplete.
Bounded Arrow/Parquet open-data and streaming publication paths exist; complete Iceberg/Delta table lifecycle and public SQL service remain incomplete.

Notebook execution and pipeline IR foundations exist; bounded read-only SQL over registered Parquet is exposed through HTTP/OpenAPI/SDK/Studio; notebook/SQL/pipeline CRUD and broader authoring surfaces remain incomplete.

Durable workflow snapshots/task runs, lease-fenced attempts/retries/dependencies, deterministic task-to-Job planning, execution outbox/reconciliation, deployment-aware controller, timezone-aware cron, durable event inbox/delivery, cancellation, timeout enforcement, snapshot-safe bounded backfill, shared resource pools, generation-fenced leader authority, leader-guarded scheduler services, continuous daemon orchestration, group backfill cancellation, and a bounded fail-closed conditional-branch contract with explicit skip decisions exist; durable branch-state integration, notifications, broad operator execution, public scheduler APIs/UI, process/deployment wiring and PostgreSQL multi-node HA qualification remain incomplete.

Governed assets/revisions, bounded project-scoped catalog search across identity and governance metadata, declared/observed lineage persistence, deterministic dependency-free OpenLineage-style event export, and explicit selected-subgraph Bundle export/planning/atomic import exist; glossary/classification authoring, event transport/standard certification, and complete asset-family integration remain incomplete.

Ontology object/property/link/action schemas and persistence, bounded stable-key object-instance materialization, deterministic declared-link resolution with cardinality checks, bounded object-type/neighbor graph queries, SQLite graph persistence, and authorized injected action dispatch with optional idempotent replay callbacks exist; durable action replay storage, public interfaces and production qualification remain incomplete.

A bounded, read-only RQL SELECT parser/executor now supports ontology-type filtering, equality predicates, and explicit result limits over materialized KnowledgeGraph views; traversal, joins, planning, provider execution, and public API exposure remain incomplete.

Versioned contracts/rules/results and persistence exist; built-in null, unique, range, domain, row-count, freshness, referential, and explicitly injected sandboxed SQL/Python predicate execution plus provider-neutral scheduler-facing quality_gate release decisions and controller release-policy enforcement exist; alerts and UI remain incomplete.

Experiment/run/model/evaluation metadata, provenance persistence, deterministic tabular training, digest-verified registered inference, and champion-model serving resolution exist; feature engineering, broader algorithms, MLflow interoperability, network serving APIs and production qualification remain incomplete.

Provider/prompt/vector/RAG/tool/agent contracts and persistence, OpenAI-compatible chat/embedding execution with optional token-usage callback, deterministic vector indexing/retrieval, bounded RAG execution, and bounded declared-tool agent loops with non-idempotent authorization plus optional tool telemetry callbacks exist; evaluation and production provider qualification remain incomplete.

Safe semantic-model contracts, canonical model/query/tile/dashboard serialization, project-scoped SQLite model and dashboard persistence, parameterized metric compiler, SQL-backed metric runtime, and dashboard tile execution exist; relationships, joins, calculated metrics, dashboard APIs/UI and production qualification remain incomplete.

Kafka JSON polling with Ronin-owned offsets, durable SQLite compare-and-set checkpoints, checkpoint-safe micro-batch processing, identity transforms, idempotent Parquet sinks, bounded deterministic event-time windows with watermark/late-record classification, idempotent durable SQLite stream-table storage, and deterministic stream-record to scheduler-event inbox integration exist; production qualification remains incomplete.

Durable normalized metrics/events, threshold alert state transitions, deterministic alert and budget notification intents, bounded HTTPS webhook delivery, dependency-free deterministic Prometheus text export, reusable execution instrumentation, LocalWorkerRuntime instrumentation callbacks in one-shot and continuous loops, usage pricing, cost records, budget evaluation, and deny-new-work budget_gate decisions exist; broader service adoption and production qualification remain incomplete.

Typed grants, bearer authorization, transport policy, fail-closed OIDC JWT validation, provisioned principals/groups, composed authenticated-actor hydration, authoritative group checks, append-only audit foundations, and security reporting policy exist; role administration, automatic audit instrumentation and production secret backends remain incomplete.

Local/container/Compose foundation, PostgreSQL metadata adapter with transactional migration and healthcheck, SQLite online backup/restore primitives, S3-compatible artifact adapter, and a constrained single-replica SQLite Helm reference chart exist. PostgreSQL JobStore parity, Kubernetes production qualification, scheduler HA and production backup qualification remain incomplete.

Deterministic verified archive IO, semantic inventory, native project/connection round-trips with explicit runtime/secret remapping, atomic multi-object project+connection commit, and explicit catalog asset/revision/lineage selected-subgraph export/planning/atomic commit exist; workflow/quality/ontology/ML/GenAI/data/semantic assets, PostgreSQL JobStore parity, certification and public API surfaces remain incomplete.

Deterministic fixture discovery and fail-closed notebook-item translation exist with CLI/report tests; authenticated discovery, canonical import/export integration, provider compatibility and certification remain incomplete.

Deterministic fixture discovery and fail-closed notebook-job translation with dependency and schedule mapping exist with CLI/report tests; authenticated discovery, canonical import/export integration, provider compatibility and certification remain incomplete.

Deterministic fixture discovery and fail-closed Python-function translation exist with CLI/report tests; authenticated discovery, canonical import/export integration, provider compatibility and certification remain incomplete.

Deterministic fixture discovery and fail-closed Python/SQL recipe translation exist with CLI/report tests; authenticated discovery, canonical import/export integration, provider compatibility and certification remain incomplete.

Authenticated static Studio shell supports job listing, detail status, events, evidence, cancellation, navigation, packaged asset delivery, and a project-scoped read-only SQL workflow; authoring editors, domain workflows, and complete Public v1 journeys remain incomplete.
GitHub Actions remain disabled, main is unprotected, current exact-head automated qualification is absent, and release/security/legal evidence still requires blocked or human-owned work.

human_decisions.summary: Runtime capability namespace, value semantics and ambiguity policy.
Language-neutral runner protocol family and compatibility semantics.
License/NOTICE/attribution conclusions and release approval remain human review decisions.

next_critical_path: Keep construction/status docs synchronized with PUBLIC_V1_SCOPE.md.
Complete scheduler broad task adapters, branching/notifications, public scheduler APIs/UI, process/deployment wiring and PostgreSQL HA semantics/qualification.

Extend native Bundle support to the next executable canonical metadata family, preferring workflow/pipeline persistence if its canonical snapshot/store contracts preserve identity without deployment locators; then quality/ontology/ML/GenAI as their contracts permit.
Finish storage ports for remaining domains, then add PostgreSQL JobStore parity and qualify the existing S3-compatible artifact adapter.
Implement Arrow/Parquet, a reference open lakehouse table profile and a reference SQL engine before broad vendor migration adapters.
Complete remote connectors and safe incremental checkpoint execution.
Expand Public v1 API and extend Web Studio from the verified job/evidence shell to documented domain APIs and authoring workflows.
Implement remaining quality, ontology/KG/RQL, ML, GenAI, semantic, streaming, observability/alerts/FinOps and security runtime paths.
Implement Kubernetes and four certified migration profiles only after their canonical target capabilities execute end to end.
Restore exact-head CI/release qualification only with maintainer authorization and do not claim release readiness before it exists.
